structured_summary: The robot announces the package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery (by speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must give a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The robot should announce the delivery via speech.
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: Timeout behavior if user does not acknowledge within 8 seconds
Failure handling if robot fails to announce delivery

Whether robot retries announcement if not heard
potential_ambiguities: Whether the deadline begins at the end of the announcement or its start
Whether a head nod is reliably detectable by the NAO robot in a quiet office
What constitutes 'receipt' of acknowledgment (timing of detection)
If multiple acknowledgments could reset the timer
